---
title: Use the CLI Interface
---

The SearcherKit command-line interface is used to run configurations, evaluate outputs, inspect configurations, and manage plugins.

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `searcher run` | Run an agent from a configuration |
| `searcher evaluate` | Score saved runs with an LLM judge |
| `searcher inspect` | Validate a composed configuration without running the agent |
| `searcher tui` | Run an interactive query in the terminal UI |
| `searcher plugins list` | List installed plugins |
| `searcher plugins deploy` | Deploy plugin data to Elasticsearch |
| `searcher plugins convert` | Convert plugin or training datasets |

### Resolving `--config-path`

`run`, `inspect`, and `tui` accept a path or a packaged configuration name.
SearcherKit first checks the path relative to the current directory, then an
absolute path, and finally the packaged configuration directory. A missing
`.yaml` suffix is tried automatically. Once loaded, Hydra-style overrides are
applied last:

```bash
searcher inspect --config-path searchagent agent.llm_client.model=demo
```

### searcher run {#cli-run}

Run a SearcherKit configuration.

```bash
searcher run --config-path searchagent
```

Arguments:

| Argument | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config-path PATH` | `None` (uses `config.yaml`) | Configuration file path or packaged configuration name. |
| `--debug` | `false` | Set the log level to `DEBUG`. |

See [Batch Run and Evaluate](../01-searching/04-batch-run-and-evaluate.qmd) for a complete batch workflow.

### searcher evaluate {#cli-evaluate}

Evaluate saved run records using an LLM judge.

```bash
searcher evaluate outputs/webexplorer outputs/webexplorer_eval \
  --max-concurrency 32
```

The evaluation process uses the `OPENAI_BASE_URL` and `OPENAI_API_KEY` environment variables.

Arguments:

| Argument | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `input_dir` | Required | Directory containing run record JSON files. |
| `output_dir` | Required | Directory in which to write evaluation result JSON files. |
| `--max-concurrency N` | `None` (runtime default) | Maximum number of records to evaluate concurrently. |
| `--answer-pattern REGEX` | Built-in answer regex | Regex used to extract the final answer before evaluation. It must contain a named capture group, `(?P<answer>...)`. |

### `searcher inspect` {#cli-inspect}

Recursively validate configuration fields against their corresponding structured config types without running the agent.

```bash
searcher inspect \
  --config-path webexplorer
```

Arguments:

| Argument | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config-path PATH` | `None` (uses `config.yaml`) | Configuration file path or packaged configuration name. |

- Raise **ERROR** when unexpected field in config (not in target dataclass) or required field missing (no default value in target dataclass)

Hydra-style overrides are also supported, the error would be raised when overriden config is invalid:

```bash
searcher inspect \
  --config-path websailor \
  agent.llm_client.model=demo
```

### searcher plugins {#cli-plugins}

#### searcher plugins list {#cli-plugins-list}

List plugins or run plugin deployment tools.

```bash
searcher plugins list
```

Arguments: none.

#### searcher plugins deploy local-wiki / browsecomp-plus {#cli-plugins-deploy}

See [Build the Index](../01-searching/03-search-with-elasticsearch.qmd#build-index) for the full indexing workflow.

Common arguments:

| Argument | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--es_host URL` | Required | Elasticsearch URL. |
| `--es_username TEXT` | `None` | Elasticsearch username. Must be provided together with the password. |
| `--es_password TEXT` | `None` | Elasticsearch password. Must be provided together with the username. |
| `--index_name TEXT` | Required | Elasticsearch index name. |
| `--model_name TEXT` | `""` | SentenceTransformer model name or path. Required with `--dense-vector`. |
| `--embedding_dim N` | `0` | Dense-vector dimension. |
| `--prompt_strategy {none,e5,qwen3}` | `none` | Embedding prompt strategy. |
| `--batch_size N` (alias `--cpu_batch_size`) | `200` | CPU document batch size. |
| `--embedding_batch_size N` (alias `--gpu_batch_size`) | `16` | Embedding batch size. |
| `--max_text_chars N` | `32768` | Maximum number of text characters per document. |
| `--limit N` | `None` | Maximum number of documents to process. |
| `--shards N` | `1` | Number of Elasticsearch shards. |
| `--replicas N` | `0` | Number of Elasticsearch replicas. |
| `--overwrite` | `false` | Replace an existing index. |
| `--dense-vector` | `false` | Enable dense-vector indexing. |

`local-wiki` arguments:

| Argument | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--wiki_dump_path PATH` | Required | Path to a MediaWiki XML or XML.bz2 dump. |
| `--base_url URL` | `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/` | Base URL used to construct Wiki page links. |

Deploy a local Wiki index:

```bash
searcher plugins deploy local-wiki \
  --wiki_dump_path data/wiki.xml.bz2 \
  --es_host http://127.0.0.1:9200 \
  --index_name wiki_local \
  --overwrite
```

`browsecomp-plus` arguments:

| Argument | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dataset_path PATH` | Required | Hugging Face dataset name or local JSON, JSONL, or Parquet path. |
| `--split TEXT` | `train` | Dataset split. |

Add `--dense-vector --model_name Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B --embedding_dim 1024`
to enable dense-vector indexing.

#### searcher plugins convert{#cli-plugins-convert}

Run the dataset conversion command provided by the plugin. Remaining arguments are forwarded to the conversion tool:

```bash
searcher plugins convert --help
```

Arguments:

| Argument | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `input_path` | Required | Input OpenSeeker JSONL dataset path. |
| `output_path` | Required | Output MS-Swift JSONL dataset path. |
| `--max-records N` | `0` (unlimited) | Maximum number of records to convert. |

### searcher tui`{#cli-tui}

Run queries in the terminal UI. See [Use the Interactive TUI](02-use-the-interactive-tui.qmd) for the complete workflow.

```bash
searcher tui --config-path configs/demo/config.yaml
```

Arguments:

| Argument | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config-path PATH` | `None` (uses `config.yaml`) | Configuration file path or packaged configuration name. |
| `--debug` | `false` | Set the log level to `DEBUG`. |
| `--env-file PATH` | `.env` | Dotenv file from which to load LLM environment variables. |
| `--query TEXT` | `None` | Run one query non-interactively. |
| `--interactive-output-path PATH` | `None` | Directory for interactive run records. |
